_readme: EXAMPLE ONLY — not read by the app (the live file is `update.json`). This is the intranet variant: `provider: "share"` reads the manifest and installer from a file share and never touches the internet. Put your copy at `update.json` NEXT TO THE EXE, not in assets/: that location wins over assets/update.json and, unlike it, is not overwritten by the next installer run. Windows-only. See .claude/docs/auto-update.md.
